newsitem.title: GERMANY: German builders see 400,000 jobless in sector.
newsitem.headline: German builders see 400,000 jobless in sector.

text.p: Germany's main construction employers group said on Thursday it feared that continued hard winter weather in February would lead to around 400,000 being unemployed in the industry in the coming weeks.

Speaking at news conference, Otmar Franz, president of the German construction industry organisation HDB, called on government authorities not to seek further cost-savings in public infrastructure projects.

He said that some 245,600 builders, 24 percent of the sector's workforce, were already without a job and blamed the decline in public sector spending as one of the main reasons for the drop in employment.

Franz added that public investment in building projects had in real terms already in 1996 fallen below levels reached in 1963, and that he expected a further three percent drop in investment this year
